description: This file provides utility functions and a class for determining application-specific directories across different operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and Unix/Linux, following various standards like XDG. It includes methods for user data, config, cache, state, and log directories, and internal platform-specific implementations for Windows folder retrieval.

classes.name: AppDirs
classes.description: A convenience wrapper class for accessing various application directories based on provided application name, author, version, and platform-specific settings.

methods.name: user_data_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the user-specific data directory for the application, considering OS-specific standards and optional parameters like app name, author, version, and roaming.

methods.name: site_data_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the shared data directory for the application, following OS-specific conventions.

methods.name: user_config_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the user-specific configuration directory for the application.

methods.name: site_config_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the shared configuration directory for the application.

methods.name: user_cache_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the user-specific cache directory for the application.

methods.name: user_state_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the user-specific state directory for the application.

methods.name: user_log_dir
methods.description: Returns the full path to the user-specific log directory for the application.

search-terms: user data, config, cache, state, log directories
